places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Swift but shallow and cold; Augustus and Pea cross it scouting and chase buffalo. Later the whole herd crosses safely, to the crew's pride.

places.raw_name: a good-sized creek / the cave in the riverbank
places.name: Augustus and Pea Eye's creek dugout
places.note: Ambushed by about twenty Indians, the two hole up in a cave dug under a steep bank; Augustus is badly wounded, a flood rises, and Pea swims out at night for help.
places.location_hint: prairie creek in Montana roughly three or more days' ride and over a hundred miles north of the Yellowstone, short of the Milk River; it apparently drains south toward the Yellowstone near Miles City; Pea walked about four days south from it to the herd

places.name: Montana
places.note: Vast open plains with wild swings of weather; Pea Eye staggers naked and barefoot south across it for days, sensing Deets guiding him.
places.location_hint: Montana Territory north of the Yellowstone

places.name: Miles City
places.note: Augustus jokes about seeking champagne there and later asks to be carried there for care.
places.location_hint: on the Yellowstone, downstream of the besieged creek's mouth

places.name: Missouri River
places.note: Augustus warns Jasper this big river still lies farther north.

places.name: Milk River
places.note: Jake spoke of it; the scouts haven't reached it yet, and Pea wonders about its name.

places.name: Marias River
places.note: Another northern river Jake had described.
places.location_hint: northern Montana, tributary of the Missouri

places.name: Mississippi River
places.note: Jasper heard a rumor the Yellowstone was as big and deep as it.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Jake claimed the finest land lay far north near it; Augustus jokes about finding it.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Jasper longs to step into a saloon there again.

places.name: St. Louis
places.note: Lippy says he needn't have a city like it, just any town with a saloon.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Where most drives end, close to home compared with Montana.

places.name: Texas
places.note: The hands doubt they can make it back there in winter; Pea wishes they had stayed where Indians were mostly beaten.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jasper recalls predicting there they'd cross the Yellowstone on ice; Augustus recalls a widow Pea might have courted there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Seguin
places.note: Augustus thinks old ranger Barlow settled there and married a widow.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: camped a day north of the Yellowstone after crossing it; Dish left in charge to trail north, Pea Eye recovering at the wagon

groups.label: Augustus
groups.at: Augustus and Pea Eye's creek dugout
groups.hint: alone and wounded in a dugout under a creek bank, surrounded by Indians, over a hundred miles north of the Yellowstone

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: riding north from the herd on the mare with a spare horse to rescue Augustus
